item.title: 1,400-Mile 2023 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 Coupe 6-Speed
item.description: This 2023 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 coupe was purchased new by the seller at Bowman Chevrolet of Clarkston, Michigan, and it is powered by a supercharged 6.2-liter V8 paired with a six-speed manual transmission. item.title: 2,200-Mile 2009 Mercedes-Benz SL65 AMG Black Series
item.description: This 2009 Mercedes-Benz SL65 AMG Black Series is one of 350 examples produced, 175 of which were designated for the US market, and it was delivered new to Mercedes-Benz of West Covina, California. The car was registered in the US from new up until July 2024, when it was imported into Canada before it later reentered the US, and it has 2,200 miles following history with two registered owners. item.title: 1977 MV Agusta 850SS
item.description: This 1977 MV Agusta 850SS was sold new in June 1978 at Halyak Cycle of Livermore, California, and was purchased by its current owner from its second owner of 32 years in 2014. item.title: Gen V LT1-Powered 1988 Toyota Land Cruiser FJ62
item.description: This 1988 Toyota Land Cruiser FJ62 underwent a refurbishment initiated in 2023 by BaderInk of Calabasas, California, which involved fitting a crate 6.2-liter Gen V LT1 V8 and a 6L80E six-speed automatic transmission. The truck rides on an Old Man Emu lift kit and 17" U.S. wheels with 33" Rolling Big Power tires, and the body has been refinished in Chalk over black seat upholstery with patterned inserts. item.description: This 1971 Mercedes-Benz 280SE is one of approximately 1,230 3.5 cabriolets produced between 1969 and 1971. item.title: 1934 Ford Five-Window Coupe Hot Rod at No Reserve
item.description: This 1934 Ford five-window coupe is the product of a multi-year build by Todd Lewis of Xtreme Restorations in Slatersville, Rhode Island. item.title: 1992 Porsche 911 Carrera RS
item.description: This Japanese-market 1992 Porsche 911 Carrera RS was imported to the US in July 2013 and was purchased by the current owner in 2022. Finished in Polar Silver Metallic over black and gray multi-tone leather upholstery, the car is powered by a 3.6-liter flat-six linked to a five-speed manual transaxle and a limited-slip differential. item.title: SEMA-Displayed 1987 AM General M998 HMMWV
item.description: This 1987 AM General M998 HMMWV was acquired by the prior owner in 2021 and rebuilt and modified for the 2022 SEMA show with collaboration from Plan B Trucks of Utah. item.title: 6k-Mile 2012 Mercedes-Benz C63 AMG Black Series
item.description: This 2012 Mercedes-Benz C63 AMG Black Series was sold on BaT in August 2023 and has since spent time in Canada and California where 200 miles have been added. The Obsidian Black-over-Black coupe is powered by a 6.2-liter M156 V8 linked with a seven-speed AMG Speedshift MCT automatic transmission and a limited-slip differential. Black Series-specific equipment includes a revised engine control unit, a lightened crankshaft, and forged pistons and connecting rods as well as an adjustable suspension
